(in person at 1916 McAllister St) Monday, October 19 (7:00 PM – 8:30 PM) SF EWOC Local Meeting (zoom and in person at 1916 McAllister St) Ballot Measure Turnout Tuesday Today: Join the Electoral Board as we call new and existing members to let them know about our upcoming events for Yes on Prop B, Yes on Prop I, and No on Prop D! Join us at the DSA SF Office ( 1916 McAllister St ) from 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM. If you can’t make it in person, you can still make calls on your own, just RSVP and you’ll get a link to join! RSVP here ! Organizing Mindset Training: Basebuilding 101, How to Have an Effective Organizing Conversation Every Thursday at 7:00 PM from September 17 through October 8 at the DSA SF Office, 1916 McAllister St. Talking to people is central to effective organizing, but how do you embark on an organizing conversation? Organizing Mindset Training is a four-part event series that goes in depth into every aspect of the organizing conversation so that it’s a sharpened and ready-to-use tool for any campaign. After this training, participants will: Learn about the differences between organizing, advocacy, and direct services/mutual aid Understand of the role of an Organizing Committee and carrying out an organizing strategy Overview the Organizing Conversation and get in-depth practice for each step Develop the ability to have multiple successive organizing conversations with a person, with the goal of getting them more involved in your organizing Attendance of all four sessions isn’t required, but it is encouraged! RSVP here! Prop B Mobilizations Come join our Yes on B mobilizations this weekend! Ballots are out so there is no better time to fight for a Public Bank in San Francisco. On Saturday, October 10 we’ll be joined by the Harvey Milk LGBTQ Democratic Club, the Yes on I, No on D, and Gary McCoy campaigns for a canvass and lit drop at Walter Haas Playground in Glen Park. On Sunday, October 11 join us for a rally and lit drop at Minnie & Lovie Ward Recreational Center in the Excelsior! RSVP for Saturday here and Sunday here . Please note that non-endorsed campaigns will be present, so please use your best judgement for lit drop participation with these campaigns. No Appetite for Apartheid Canvass Join us for our No Appetite for Apartheid campaign this Sunday, October 11 from 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM ! We are working to build public support for stores in SF that have pledged to go apartheid-free, and talk to people about products to boycott. We’ll meet at Mission Dolores Park nearby the Miguel Hidalgo Statue. We will first train you on how to talk to people, and then you will put that training into practice by collecting signatures around the park! Free Palestine RSVP Here ! Decolonization Studies Come join your friendly neighborhood socialists for the third session of Decolonization Studies! On Saturday, October 24th we’re discussing a collection of texts chosen to elevate our understanding of decolonization and socialism, reading is done beforehand and participants are invited to the DSA SF office ( 1916 McAllister St ) for an in person facilitated discussion. Please feel free to come to the session even if you’ve only partially completed the readings or you missed the first one! Masks are required and provided! RSVP Here ! Reportback: Bay Resistance Coalition Last Tuesday, September 29th, DSA SF joined several organizations in the Bay Resistance Coalition to protest at the OpenAI conference. Sam Altman was the main speaker. We were out there to protest OpenAI’s complicity with ICE, their technical support to the ongoing genocide in Gaza, and their role in the climate crisis through the continued use of data centers. We also demanded that OpenAI pledge to protect democracy should the Trump administration attempt a fascist takeover of the election. People Over Profit and billionaires were also our main slogans. The protest was very successful and drew media attention with coverage appearing on social media, local news stations, Democracy Now, Al Jazeera, just to name a few. Thank you to the electoral board and steering for supporting this action and also to those DSA members who were able to make it out to this early morning protest. DSA SF will continue to join in with other Bay Resistance coalition members to fight against any fascist and oligarch takeover of our government that want to silence the voice of the working class. Stay tuned for more information regarding other actions that are needed in the event that the upcoming election is stolen or thrown into chaos.
